fields.description: The role this placement is scoped to. Leave blank to offer it to every user. A user receives the union of every role-scoped placement they qualify for (ADR-0023).
fields.label: Role

fields.description: The stable, app-qualified surface reference this pin targets (ADR-0021): a bare app, a dashboard, an applet, or a doctype + view. Stored as data; the client resolves it.
fields.label: Surface Reference

fields.description: Region-appropriate position (ADR-0023): an edge-anchored grid cell {column, row} for the desktop, a 1-D {order} for the dock. Never raw pixels.
fields.label: Position
